notes.title: Demo to be removed
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Today we're initiating the removal of our demo of Dragon Orb. We truly hope you have enjoyed the demo and that it left you wanting more. To experience more level and challenges, head over to http://store.steampowered.com/app/711600/Dragon_Orb/ to purchase the full game.

Thank you for playing!

/WaVR Team

notes.title: Launch of Dragon Orb!
notes.notes:
Helloes! We're pleased to have launched Dragon Orb and really hope you'll enjoy this VR game. 

With Dragon Orb, we really tried to make a great real room scale game as opposed to all the teleport and locomotion type of games that have tendencies to makes people a tad motion sick. In this game, we strive to immerse the player in wondrous environments, with a clear game play and of course the traditional goal in arcade games: hunt for highscore! Cute dragons is the ultimate bonus.

Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː
